relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work focuses on enriching subgraph retrieval with attribute values. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, focusing on training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than enriching retrieved subgraphs with attributes.
